Proposal I recommend: 150k token credit (usable for 60 days), 14-day extension to pilot end date, and a 10% first-quarter committed usage discount if they convert within 45 days. I estimate this increases close probability substantially.

Attachments: proposed accelerator terms draft (accelerator_terms_v1.pdf)

Could I get an approve/modify? If greenlighted I'll generate DocuSign with the terms and route to procurement.
